properties.statement: Recorded so a regression is checkable. Reporter (session 0c19a800): "the where-am-i → ruling → build path held. The 09-14 ruling had left its three options written down with their trade-offs, so the user settled it in one word ('(a)'). And `propagate_change` flagged something worth telling the user: a chapter's 'Session N' name comes from counting chapters, not from the number typed in the title. That ties straight into three open session-number questions." Source is the 2026-09-27 report file (art:dev-storyflow-feedback-2026-09-27), which carries this 09-23 entry.
